key_insight: Fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder enables dense, layered cermet coatings, while spray route mainly controls the balance between hardness and tribological performance.
engineering_relevance: Selecting between detonation spraying and HVOF can tune WC–Co–Cr coatings for either maximum wear resistance or lower friction in high-load machine parts.
method: Compared WC–Co–Cr coatings made by detonation spray and HVOF.
Used SEM and EDS to assess morphology, microstructure, and phase distribution.
Compared coating density, microhardness, and friction behavior.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a higher average microhardness for detonation-sprayed coatings (1449 HV) and a low friction coefficient for HVOF coatings (Kt = 0.143).
watch_item: Performance depends strongly on powder homogeneity and spray parameters, so results may not transfer directly without process-specific optimization.
paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
